brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single full hex base at 0,0,0 with cover:full;top and cover:full;bottom plus 6 caps (solid) on all 6 side faces, forming sealed box. check_build meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port hex-port-louvre installed at slot 0 on the base (port:0#0,0#0) provides rain-protected ventilation through closed cell.

finish.summary: Built 1-cell closed box: full base with top+bottom covers and all 6 side caps, with one port slot fitted with hex-port-louvre for breathing. Verified no mesh clash.
